name: PANYAM NAGACHANDRA MOULI
University: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (NIT Surat)
description:
Specialized in MERN stack development, distributed systems, and DevOps, delivering scalable and high-performance enterprise applications.
Developed robust backend systems using Node.js and Express.js, building RESTful APIs and GraphQL services with optimized database interactions using PostgreSQL and MongoDB, improving response times by 50%.
Built high-performance frontend applications using React.js, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, and React Query, leveraging caching, memorization, and validation tools like Yup and React Hook Form.
Implemented secure authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth2, and LDAP, along with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
Enterprise GIS Platform: Worked on a mission-critical GIS web application for managing electrical distribution assets such as transformers, feeders, and poles.
Led platform upgrade of GE Smallworld EO Web (v5.28 → v5.35) with full cross-layer compatibility validation (UI, middleware, backend).
Improved system reliability by 30% while supporting 1000+ weekly active users ensuring zero disruption to business workflows.
Worked on a multi-tier architecture including GIS UI, middleware services, spatial backend, and enterprise datastore.
Enterprise Systems Development: Designed and developed an Enterprise File Server System using Node.js with LDAP authentication and JWT session management.
Implemented RBAC controls, REST APIs, and automated ZIP extraction pipelines for bulk uploads.
Built a QR-based Transformer Asset Tracking System: Enabled bulk ingestion via Excel Generated QR codes using Node Canvas Integrated with GIS/SAP systems for real-time asset access Used PostgreSQL and stateless APIs for scalable design.
Improved field operations efficiency and technician safety through real-time asset access.
Designed and deployed containerized microservices using Docker and Kubernetes.
Managed Kubernetes clusters ensuring high availability and reliability.
Optimized CI/CD pipelines for scalable deployments.
Implemented virtualized node modules strategy inside Kubernetes pods for faster builds.
Developed cron-based maintenance jobs and automated reporting systems using Nodemailer.
Enforced secure deployment practices, monitoring, and logging for production systems.
Contributed to a Generative AI solution for digitizing hand-drawn SRC cards.
Leveraged Vision Models, LLMs, and RAG pipelines to extract structured data from unstructured diagrams.
Generated GIS-compatible shapefiles, reducing manual effort and improving mapping accuracy.
